title: Composition operators and Carleson embeddings for the Nevanlinna class of Dirichlet series
summary: This paper systematically investigates the structural, analytical, and operator-theoretic properties of the Nevanlinna class $\mathcal{N}_u$ of Dirichlet series, introduced by Brevig and Perfekt [Adv.\ Math., 2021] and further developed by Guo \textit{et al.}\ [Ann.\ Inst.\ Fourier (Grenoble), 2025]. First, we examine the topological structure of $\mathcal{N}_u$. We then prove a Littlewood--Paley type identity for functions in $\mathcal{N}_u$, establish an equivalent characterization via vertical limit functions, and demonstrate that the interchange of limits in this identity is permissible.…
